objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, versioned, archived, translated and reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status such as editing, released or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Language of the original document version.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Configured type of document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction or work instruction.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive four-digit number per type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after which archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template that can be defined for a document type and selected when creating a document.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version instance of a document for which signatures and release information are documented.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator, initiator or acknowledgement recipient.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as document reader, document author, document checker, document approver or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign authorizations, reader access, distribution recipients or administrative permissions.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and released, versioned, archived or reactivated with it.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and released or published directly through properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document and managed without initially affecting document content or version history.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity expiration approaches and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate and archive a released document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups or persons maintained for a document for email distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation or acknowledgement.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to involved users about workflow tasks, release, validity extension, change proposals, override or acknowledgement.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where a document can be made visible.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be linked to documents in the system.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be linked to documents in the system.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be linked to documents in the system.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data that can be linked to documents in the system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new information object in the system and create a document using a selected document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and control attributes of a document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the edited document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is revised or certain changes occur.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related read and change rights for a document.

evts.name: assign_release_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser or translator participants through document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Change an existing attachment, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release workflow for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check the document and complete review tasks.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release task and the document is released.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: A workflow participant rejects a review or release task, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request and update the valid until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected released document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Invalidate a document, give the last valid approved version the status out of force, and revoke rights except the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, create a new version, restore authorizations and reactivate archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons to distribution by email or distribution for acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by email when a new version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement from distribution recipients upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Link a document with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents or master data.

o2o.description: A document is created with a selected document type.

A document can be created from a selected template.
A document is managed in versions.
Users can be assigned to a document as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator or initiator.
User groups can be assigned to a document for reader access, authorizations and distribution.
Attachments are added to and controlled with the main document.
Additional information can be added to each document.
A change proposal belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.

An override request is created for a selected document.
A reactivation request selects the document for reactivation.
A distribution list can be maintained for each document.
Persons can be assigned to a distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
Users can belong to user groups.
Signatures are documented for each released version.
A document can be specified as visible in clients.
Documents can be linked with processes.
Documents can be linked with organizational units.
Documents can be linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with master data.
Documents can reference other documents.
